mutations.contract: A part with a declared occurrence (or a same-mesh parent's) is measured at that occurrence only, so two parts on one mesh are each offered their own faces.
mutations.note: Ignores the pin, the rule before 2026-11-21: every slot of the mesh is ranked and the tie goes to the first key, so lug B is offered lug A's bore -- v2's pitch link straight bushing offered the tangential link's 1370/1371.
mutations.find:
if pin:
            return pinned_occurrences(sha, pin, self.own, self.every)
mutations.replace:
if False:
            return pinned_occurrences(sha, pin, self.own, self.every)

mutations.contract: A race with no occurrence of its own is at its same-mesh bearing's place.
mutations.note: Stops the walk at the part itself: v2's eight races, which declare nothing, would fall back to every slot.
mutations.find:
part = parts.get(part.parent) if part.parent else None
    return None
